facts.fact: The report says the National Identity System is operated by the Department of Immigration.

Under the 22 March 2024 MoU the Interior Ministry is to share issued-ID data (NIN, names, date of birth) in a CSV with Health so duplicate NINs in the eCRVS can be cleaned up, toward a unified NIN across the two systems.
The report states that ID cards with a National Identity Number have been issued by the National Identity System run by the Immigration Department.
